risks.title: Uncertainty regarding the Warner Bros. acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with multiple recent amendments (February 2026) and personal guarantee by Lawrence Ellison. Heightened language on suspensive conditions, increasing costs, and risk of non-closing. Major exposure in case of transaction failure.

risks.title: Dependence on the Ellison family
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1 and Item 7 of the 10-K, the Ellison family holds de facto control through National Amusements, Inc. Language asserting near-total control, reinforced by Lawrence Ellison's personal guarantee for Warner Bros. financing. Existential risk in case of strategic divergence.

risks.title: Post-merger integration complexity
risks.score_rationale: Present in Item 1A of the 10-K with application of pushdown accounting since August 7, 2025. Explicit mention of financial results non-comparability. Moderate intensity but sensitive context for a recent merger integrating Paramount Global and Skydance Media.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: First risk listed in Item 1A of the 10-K, ahead of financial matters. Strategic placement indicating management priority. Language acknowledging major vulnerabilities related to cyberattacks and personal data protection.

risks.title: Post-transaction contractual breach risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified following the Transactions of August 7, 2025. Certain contracts may require third-party consents or include change of control clauses. Moderate warning language but post-merger context increases relative vulnerability.

risks.title: Potential dilution from PIPE warrants
risks.score_rationale: Implicitly mentioned in the context of the Skydance transaction financing structure. Factual risk but dependent on optional exercise and stock performance. Low weighting as the risk is conditional.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSKY does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F report for the 2025 fiscal year. No information is available regarding any potential AI strategy, usage, or related risks.
